name: Continuum Restoration removes a harmful magic effect from an ally (#450)
contract: Continuum Restoration 801271's tooltip is "Restore the continuum at target location for all allies and enemies, removing all beneficial magic effects from enemies and harmful magic effects from allies". Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL with MiscValue 1 (DISPEL_MAGIC) and BasePoints 99 -> 100 dispels at TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY; effect 1 is the same at TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY; effect 2 triggers 821275, which mirrors stock Mass Dispel 39897 with SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL_MECHANIC. No script, spell_proc, spell_linked_spell or spell_dbc row exists for 801271: the behaviour is entirely native. The ally-versus-enemy split is produced by Unit::GetDispellableAuraList, which computes `bool positive = rank >= REP_FRIENDLY` and then skips every aura whose IsPositive() equals that, so a friendly target loses only its harmful magic auras. This is a regression scenario for that native handler and for Spell::EffectDispel; it makes no code change. Polymorph 118 is the fixture debuff because it is unambiguously negative and DISPEL_MAGIC. The enemy-side clauses are not asserted: a hostile unit cannot be given a beneficial aura through this harness (set_aura fixtures a player), and the "normally undispellable" clause runs through effect 2 against enemies only.
